あらすじ

Yasuko Sakamoto is studying to to become a teacher. As a part-time job he is a tutor for Yuki, the eldest daughter of a nobleman. She is however rebellious and he is finding that he is not as good at teaching as he once though.

One day a envelope arrives in the mail. There is nothing in it but a DVD. When he puts the video he sees a familiar room. It was Yuki’s room.

item.title: Ichazura ~Itazura Gokuaku Fandisc~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Real
  • 発売日: 2010-02-26
  • スコア: 7.17/10 (26 人評価)
  • 日本語名: イチャずら～いたずら極悪ファンディスク～
  • 英語名: Ichazura Itazura Gokuaku Fandisc

あらすじ

Ichazura. Ichazura is a fandisk to the game known as Itazura Gokuaku.

Itazura is the ‘main’ game where the main character basically gets arrested and goes to prison for being accused as a chikan/train molester. He gets out and decides to take revenge by being one. Ichazura is the ‘fan disk’ and covers what happens after the ‘good’ ending where he gives up being a Chikan and the girls have pretty much ‘fallen’ for him. As for how they play it’s practically the same except obviously the first one deals more with molesting and then ‘breaking’ the girls as opposed to all the scenes in Ichazura being consensual.

item.title: Itazura Gokuaku
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Real
  • 発売日: 2009-05-29
  • スコア: 6.540000000000001/10 (192 人評価)
  • 日本語名: いたずら極悪
  • 英語名: Itazura Gokuaku

あらすじ

One day, Shunsuke is falsely arrested for train molestation. He tries to prove his innocence, but his guilt is finally established. When he finishes his prison term, he soon decides to take revenge on the girls who told the police he was a train molester…. Like this, his revenge life starts…. But one day, when he does train molestation in the train, he is witnessed by the police. However, a girl saves him just when he is about to get arrested. The girl is actually his younger sister…. Yes, his one and only family member….
